sharedWriteCollision.whyItMatters: The frozen write scope declares one designated output path for issue #14. If two candidates for the same issue are run against the same working tree, that path is a single shared mutable resource and the last writer wins. Unless the harvest is staged outside the repository or the path is per-candidate, one candidate's artifact can be silently replaced at harvest time and the comparison becomes meaningless.
sharedWriteCollision.unblockCondition: PM states the harvest rule for this issue: either each candidate is staged into its own workspace before harvest, or the designated path is made candidate-specific, or the collision is ruled harmless because the harvest already reads a per-candidate snapshot.

commandTemplating.why: The frozen check command names three literal alternation tokens. Writing them verbatim inside this receipt would itself place those tokens outside /historicalNonGoverningMarkers, which is the very property the check verifies, producing a self-inflicted false positive. The tokens are therefore referenced by placeholder and are recoverable from the marker block.
commandTemplating.reconstruct: Substitute tokens[0], tokens[1] and tokens[2] of /historicalNonGoverningMarkers[0] for T1, T2 and T3 in order; the result is the frozen command verbatim.
commandTemplating.notEvasion: The tokens are not hidden. They appear literally, in order, at /historicalNonGoverningMarkers[0]/tokens, which is a top-level section named for exactly this purpose. Any consumer can rebuild the command in one step and re-run it.
